N01.title: Silk Mesh Cuff — Silver
N01.line: Soft to the eye, firm on the wrist.
N01.body: An open cuff built from a rounded tube of fine woven mesh, about 15mm wide, that ends in two mirror-polished oval caps facing each other across the opening. The mesh catches light like brushed silk, so it reads quietly on its own and holds its own beside a watch.
N01.size: Open cuff, about 6cm across inside; mesh tube about 15mm wide; gap about 2.5cm
N01.macro: Fine woven mesh tube with polished oval end caps, silver tone

N02.title: Silk Mesh Cuff — Gold
N02.line: Soft to the eye, firm on the wrist.
N02.body: An open cuff built from a rounded tube of fine woven mesh, about 15mm wide, that ends in two mirror-polished oval caps facing each other across the opening. In warm gold tone the mesh reads like woven silk, rich without any stones.
N02.size: Open cuff, about 6cm across inside; mesh tube about 15mm wide; gap about 2.5cm
N02.macro: Fine woven mesh tube with polished oval end caps, gold tone

N03.title: Garnet Cable Cuff
N03.metal: Two-tone (silver tone cable, 18k gold tone ends)
N03.stones: Two round garnet-red stones; clear pavé collars
N03.line: A twisted cable, finished in gold.
N03.body: A slim open cuff of twisted silver-tone cable, about 5mm thick, finished at each end with a gold barrel of two pavé rows and a round garnet-red stone set at the tip. The two tips sit face to face on top of the wrist, so the colour is always in view.
N03.size: Open cuff, about 6cm across inside; cable about 5mm; end barrels about 9mm
N03.macro: Gold pavé barrels with garnet-red tips on a twisted silver cable

N04.title: Triple Coil Wrap Bangle
N04.line: Three turns, one line of gold.
N04.body: One continuous snake-coil wire, finely ribbed and about 4mm thick, wraps the wrist in three stacked turns. Each end finishes in a small rectangular cap set with two rows of clear pavé, one sitting on the top turn and one on the bottom. It looks like a stack, and goes on as one piece.
N04.size: Three turns, about 14mm tall in total; wire about 4mm; flexible wrap
N04.macro: Rectangular pavé end cap on the ribbed gold coil

N05.title: Marquise Wheat Cuff
N05.stones: Clear marquise-cut cubic zirconia, two rows
N05.line: Two rows of light, leaning into each other.
N05.body: An open gold cuff whose front is set with two rows of marquise-cut clear stones, each in its own fine claws and angled like the two sides of a wheat ear. The back is a slim plain band finished with small polished balls, so it slips on at the narrowest part of the wrist.
N05.size: Open cuff; stone rows about 14mm wide; each marquise about 7mm
N05.macro: Two slanted rows of claw-set marquise stones

N06.title: Baguette Line Bracelet
N06.body: A tennis bracelet of clear rectangular baguettes set crosswise, side by side, each in a slim gold box setting, closed with a gold box clasp. About 4mm wide, it is fine enough to wear every day and bright enough for evening.
N06.size: Line about 4mm wide; box clasp; length to confirm (about 17cm)
N06.macro: Crosswise clear baguettes in slim gold box settings

N07.title: Droplet Open Ring — Silver
N07.line: A ball and a drop, almost touching.
N07.body: An open ring of smooth polished wire that swells at one end into a round ball and at the other into a long teardrop, the two sitting side by side on top of the finger. Open at the back, so it adjusts to fit.
N07.size: Adjustable open ring; ball about 7mm; teardrop about 9mm
N07.macro: Polished ball and teardrop ends, silver tone

N08.title: Droplet Open Ring — Gold
N08.line: A ball and a drop, almost touching.
N08.body: An open ring of smooth polished wire that swells at one end into a round ball and at the other into a long teardrop, the two sitting side by side on top of the finger. Open at the back, so it adjusts to fit.
N08.size: Adjustable open ring; ball about 7mm; teardrop about 9mm
N08.macro: Polished ball and teardrop ends, gold tone

N09.title: North Star Bangle — Silver
N09.body: A slim flat bangle in mirror-polished silver tone, about 6mm wide, its outer face alternating an engraved eight-point north star with a tiny stone at its heart and a round clear stone set flush in a bezel.
N09.size: Rigid oval bangle; band about 6mm; inner size to confirm
N09.macro: Engraved north star beside a bezel-set round stone

N10.title: Tile Stone Bangle — Gold
N10.body: A slim gold bangle built from a row of square tiles, about 4mm each, alternating plain polished gold with a round clear stone framed in a square bezel. Clean and graphic, it stacks easily.
N10.size: Rigid bangle; band about 4mm; inner size to confirm
N10.macro: Square tiles, plain and stone-set in turn

N11.title: Kiss Knot Bangle — Silver
N11.body: A flexible snake-coil bangle, finely ribbed and about 5mm thick, whose two ends cross on top of the wrist under one smooth polished X.
N11.size: Flexible bangle; coil about 5mm; X about 12mm
N11.macro: Polished X binding the ribbed silver coil

N12.title: Kiss Knot Bangle — Gold
N12.body: A flexible snake-coil bangle, finely ribbed and about 5mm thick, whose two ends cross on top of the wrist under one smooth polished X.
N12.size: Flexible bangle; coil about 5mm; X about 12mm
N12.macro: Polished X binding the ribbed gold coil

N13.title: Mint Pear Drop Earrings
N13.stones: Pale mint-green pear cubic zirconia; three clear pears per earring
N13.line: Three small lights, then one of mint.
N13.body: From the stud, a short curved line of three small clear pear-cut stones leads down to one larger pear in pale mint green, every stone held in fine gold claws. About 22mm long, it falls just below the lobe.
N13.size: About 22mm long; mint pear about 9mm; butterfly backs
N13.macro: Mint pear and three clear pears in fine gold claws

N14.title: Duo Link Necklace
N14.metal: Two-tone (18k gold tone and silver tone)
N14.line: Gold and silver, in one line.
N14.body: Long oval links in gold tone and silver tone, mixed along the chain and joined by small stacked gold rings, finished with a lobster clasp and a short extender. It settles at the collarbone and wears well with both metals.
N14.macro: Gold and silver oval links joined by stacked gold rings

N15.title: Duo Link Bracelet
N15.metal: Two-tone (18k gold tone and silver tone)
N15.line: Gold and silver, in one line.
N15.body: The bracelet to the Duo Link Necklace: long oval links in gold tone and silver tone joined by small stacked gold rings, with a lobster clasp and extender.
N15.macro: Gold and silver oval links joined by stacked gold rings

N16.title: Ruby Baguette Bracelet
N16.set: Ruby Baguette Set (Bracelet, Necklace, Huggies, Band)
N16.line: Deep red, in a straight line.
N16.body: A tennis bracelet of ruby-red rectangular baguettes set crosswise, side by side, each held at its corners by gold claws, closed with a box clasp and a fold-over safety tongue. About 5mm wide.
N16.size: Line about 5mm wide; box clasp with safety; length to confirm (about 17cm)
N16.macro: Ruby-red baguettes in gold corner claws

N17.title: Emerald Baguette Bracelet
N17.body: A tennis bracelet of emerald-green rectangular baguettes set crosswise, side by side, each held at its corners by gold claws, closed with a box clasp and a fold-over safety tongue. About 5mm wide.
N17.size: Line about 5mm wide; box clasp with safety; length to confirm (about 17cm)
N17.macro: Emerald-green baguettes in gold corner claws

N18.title: Emerald Baguette Band
N18.body: An eternity band set all the way round with emerald-green baguettes laid crosswise, edge to edge, each held by small gold claws. About 5mm wide.
N18.size: Band about 5mm wide; sample tagged size 9 (US); other sizes to confirm
N18.macro: Crosswise emerald baguettes around the band

N19.title: Ruby Baguette Band
N19.set: Ruby Baguette Set (Bracelet, Necklace, Huggies, Band)
N19.body: An eternity band set all the way round with raspberry-ruby baguettes laid crosswise, edge to edge, each held by small gold claws. About 5mm wide.
N19.size: Band about 5mm wide; ring size to confirm
N19.macro: Crosswise ruby baguettes around the band

N20.title: Pearl Nugget Hoops
N20.stones: One round white pearl per hoop (pearl type to confirm)
N20.line: A pearl, held in a glitter of gold.
N20.body: Small gold hoops whose lower curve is crowded with short faceted gold beads, slightly jumbled so the edge catches light, cradling one round white pearl inside each hoop. Hinged lever backs.
N20.size: About 22mm across; pearl about 10mm; lever-back closure
N20.macro: Round white pearl inside a collar of faceted gold beads

N21.title: Emerald Halo C-Hoops — Silver
N21.stones: Emerald-green round cubic zirconia with clear pavé halos
N21.body: Open C-shaped half hoops in bright silver tone, their front faces set with a row of small round emerald-green stones, each ringed in tiny clear pavé. Post backs.
N21.macro: Emerald stones ringed in clear pavé along the C-hoop

N22.title: Ruby Baguette Necklace
N22.set: Ruby Baguette Set (Bracelet, Necklace, Huggies, Band)
N22.line: Deep red, all the way round.
N22.body: A tennis necklace of ruby-red baguettes set crosswise, side by side, each held at its corners by gold claws, closed with a box clasp. About 5mm wide, it sits close at the base of the neck.
N22.size: Length to confirm (about 40cm); line about 5mm wide; box clasp
N22.macro: Ruby-red baguettes in gold corner claws

N23.title: Ruby Baguette Huggies
N23.set: Ruby Baguette Set (Bracelet, Necklace, Huggies, Band)
N23.body: Gold huggie hoops with one row of ruby-red baguettes standing crosswise along the lower front, the upper half plain polished gold. Hinged snap closure.
N23.macro: Row of ruby baguettes along the huggie

N24.title: Emerald Deco Hoops — Silver
N24.stones: Emerald-green square cubic zirconia alternating with clear baguettes
N24.body: Chunky silver-tone hoops set all the way round the front with square emerald-cut green stones alternating with pairs of clear baguettes, each in bright claws. Post backs.
N24.macro: Square emerald stone between clear baguettes

N25.title: Birthstone Heart Necklace
N25.stones: One heart-cut cubic zirconia in the month's colour
N25.line: A small heart, in your month's colour.
N25.body: A fine gold cable chain carrying one small heart-cut stone in four slim claws, the chain fixed at the heart's shoulders so it always sits straight. Choose the colour for your month, or for someone else's.
N25.size: Heart about 7mm; chain length to confirm (about 40cm plus extender)
N25.macro: Heart-cut stone in four gold claws

P01.title: Tubogas Dome Ring
P01.line: The tubogas idea, scaled to one finger.
P01.body: A wide ring of flexible tubogas, about 10mm across the finger, its puffed dome face banded all the way round with fine polished ridges that move like an accordion as the hand bends. No stones, no seams to catch, just a lot of light from one shape. Wear it alone or stacked with a slim band.
P01.size: Band about 10mm wide; US ring sizes 6, 7 and 8 (3 pcs each on this PI)
P01.macro: Fine parallel ridges of the tubogas dome

P05.title: Fine Tennis Bracelet
P05.body: One continuous row of small round brilliant clear cubic zirconia, each about 2.5mm and each in its own gold claw cup, closed with a slim box clasp. Finer than our Rivière Eternal, so it slips under a cuff or stacks with a watch without crowding it.
P05.size: About 17cm long (confirm on sample); stones about 2.5mm
P05.macro: Small round stones in gold claw cups, box clasp

P06.title: Petal Flower Studs
P06.line: A small flower, cut to catch light.
P06.body: Each stud is a four petal bloom: three round clear cubic zirconia around a polished metal centre, and one larger pear cut stone falling below like a petal caught mid-drop. All claw set, on a straight post with a butterfly back, so it sits flat and close to the lobe.
P06.size: Each stud about 13mm tall; round stones about 4mm (confirm on sample)
P06.macro: Three round petals and the pear petal around the polished centre

P07.title: Droplet Open Cuff
P07.line: Two endings, one round, one falling.
P07.body: A slim polished open cuff that finishes in two different shapes: a round ball on one end and a smooth teardrop on the other, sitting across a small gap. Matches our Droplet Open Ring, so the two can be worn as a pair.
P07.size: Open cuff about 6cm across inside; wire about 3mm; ball about 9mm (confirm on sample)
P07.macro: The ball end and the teardrop end across the opening

P08.title: Roman Numeral Trio Ring
P08.metal: Rose gold, silver and gold tone
P08.line: Three metals, one stack, a clock's worth of numerals.
P08.body: Three bands worn as one: a slim rose gold band engraved with Roman numerals and set with small round stones, a silver tone band with two rows of pavé, and a wider gold band with Roman numerals cut right through the metal. Stacked flush, they read as one considered ring.
P08.size: About 16mm tall in total (4mm + 4mm + 8mm per supplier diagram); US ring sizes 6, 7 and 8 (3 pcs each on this PI)
P08.macro: Engraved numerals, pavé rows and cut-out numerals

P09.title: Linked Trio Ring
P09.line: Three rings that refuse to be separated.
P09.body: A polished band studded with round bezel set stones, a slim pavé band and a ring of box chain, joined by small jump rings so they move together. Wear all three on one finger or spread them across two.
P09.size: Studded band about 5mm, pavé band about 2.5mm; US ring sizes 6, 7 and 8 (3 pcs each on this PI)
P09.macro: The studded band and pavé band joined by a jump ring

P11.title: Crystal Baguette Eternity Ring
P11.line: Straight lines, all the way round.
P11.body: A full eternity band of clear baguette cut cubic zirconia set crosswise, each stone held by tall gold claws that rise between the stones like a small crown. Bright from every angle, because there is no back to it.
P11.size: Band about 5mm wide; US ring sizes 6, 7 and 8 (3 pcs each on this PI)
P11.macro: Baguettes and the tall claws between them

P12.title: Chain Drop Dome Ring
P12.line: A ring with something to say when you move.
P12.body: A chunky polished dome band wrapped by two slim pavé collars, with a short swag of chain between them and a single pear cut stone hanging from it. Quiet when still, a small swing of light when the hand moves.
P12.size: Band about 6mm wide; pear about 7mm; US ring sizes 6, 7 and 8 (3 pcs each on this PI)
P12.macro: Pavé collar, chain swag and pear drop

P13.title: Watch Link Ring
P13.line: A watch strap, kept for the finger.
P13.body: A wide band built like a classic watch bracelet: three rows of polished links with a softly scalloped edge, smooth on the inside. Heavy looking, comfortable to wear, and very good with a real watch on the same hand.
P13.size: Band about 11mm wide; US ring sizes 6, 7 and 8 (3 pcs each on this PI)
P13.macro: Three rows of polished watch-style links

P14.title: Marquise Drop Choker
P14.line: A clean collar with one long thought.
P14.body: A smooth round omega collar sits close at the base of the throat with a marquise cut stone set sideways at the front. From it, a fine chain falls about 6cm with a small pear stone halfway and another at the end.
P14.size: Collar about 2mm; marquise about 10mm; drop about 6cm (confirm length on sample)
P14.macro: Marquise stone and the start of the drop

P15.title: Mesh Band Ring
P15.line: The Silk Mesh texture, cut to a ring.
P15.body: A wide band of fine woven metal mesh with neat rolled edges, soft to the eye and flexible on the finger. Pairs with the Silk Mesh Cuff.
P15.size: Band about 10mm wide; US ring sizes 6, 7 and 8 (3 pcs each on this PI)
P15.macro: Woven mesh texture and rolled edge

P20.title: Bold Nocturne Drops
P20.line: The Bold Nocturne link, worn at the ear.
P20.body: Each earring is a polished oval link on a post with a larger pavé set oval link hanging below it, the same links as our Bold Nocturne Chain and Bracelet. Bold enough to wear alone.
P20.size: Each earring about 30mm long (confirm on sample)
P20.macro: Pavé oval link hanging from its polished link

P23.title: Pear Point Open Cuff
P23.line: Two points of light, facing each other.
P23.body: A slim polished open cuff that tapers to its two ends, each finished with one pear cut clear stone in a claw setting. The two pears face each other across the opening, right where the wrist turns.
P23.size: Open cuff about 6cm across inside; pears about 7mm (confirm on sample)
P23.macro: The two pear stone ends across the opening

C1.line: One green square, no piercing needed.
C1.body: An ear cuff of slim polished gold wire that slides onto the middle ridge of the ear, carrying one square princess cut emerald green stone in four claws. Wear it alone or with the Crystal Pear Ear Cuff above it.
C1.size: Cuff about 12mm across; stone about 5mm (confirm on sample)
C1.macro: Square emerald-green stone in four gold claws

C2.line: One clear pear, no piercing needed.
C2.body: An ear cuff of slim polished gold wire that slides onto the middle ridge of the ear, carrying one clear pear cut stone in gold claws. Wear it alone or with the Emerald Square Ear Cuff.
C2.size: Cuff about 12mm across; pear about 7mm (confirm on sample)
C2.macro: Clear pear stone in gold claws
